Chapter 6765: You’Re Not Worthy

Chapter 6765: You’re Not Worthy

“You dare?!” An imperial aura erupted like a storm.

Unfortunately, it was too late since the lord swung without any hesitation, decapitating the youth. Blood gushed into the air from the exposed neck. The youth’s head rolled on the ground; his eyes opened wide in disbelief.

Not to mention a king, even an emperor would have died from the slash.

“?!!” The crowd shared the same astonishment.

Although Venerable Dragon Kingdom was relatively strong, it was nothing compared to Sky Zenith. This might result in total destruction.

“You deserve death!” An incredible aura erupted.

“Emerald Grand Emperor!” Everyone became alarmed.

“Splash!” It didn’t take long before someone riding green waves appeared nearby.

“He’s here.” Some felt their legs going weak, dropping to the ground.

“Whoosh!” A slash cut through the air, aiming to decapitate the lord.

“Damn!” His expression darkened since he stood no chance against an emperor beastmaster.

“Just one slash.” Spectators shuddered at the emperor’s ability to deliver a killing blow from an immense distance.

“Bam!” Li Qiye flicked his finger and nullified the attack while still sipping tea.

“Who?!” Emerald Emperor realized something was wrong and stared at him.

Alas, he paid no mind to the shouting emperor.

Spectators also regained their wits but didn’t quite grasp what had happened.

“Who are you?” The emperor asked again.

All eyes were on Li Qiye, noticing that he was just an ordinary mortal. Why was the emperor speaking to him with such a serious tone?

The lord approached and kneeled, offering Dracowrath with both hands.

“Very good, the divinity is still present.” Li Qiye accepted it for a closer look, nodding approvingly.

Meanwhile, the emperor didn’t appreciate being treated as air. His eyes gleamed with murderous intent.

“State your name.” Nevertheless, he didn’t resort to an unannounced attack.

“You are not worthy of knowing the young noble’s name. Kneel and beg for forgiveness.” Xiaoyue answered instead.

This naturally astounded the listeners.

“Is she crazy? Am I hearing this right?” Someone asked incredulously. An emperor was a top existence in their world, looming above everyone.

Now, these two nobodies dared to speak to him in this manner. Not even Dragon Ancestor and Phoenix Emperor would do so.

“They’re courting death.” The crowd shared the same thought.

“Beg for forgiveness?” Emerald himself thought he had misheard her and paused for a moment. Afterward, he declared: “I do not kill no-name juniors, state your master’s name and I may spare you.”

“So noisy.” Xiaoyue reached for him.

Emerald reacted fast enough and furiously shouted: “Emerald Whale!”

“Splash!” He conjured an ocean with a whale within. Its tail could swipe the stars above.

“Bam!” It delivered a devastating tail whip against Xiao Yue, capable of obliterating one hundred thousand miles in the blink of an eye.

The crowd could already see the opponents being crushed to mincemeat. However, contrary to their expectation, her hand pierced the whale. Its blood rained down as it wailed in agony and took its final breath.

Others became speechless while staring at the falling corpse of an emperor beast. The escaping emperor was caught instantly despite activating numerous defensive treasures to stop Xiaoyue.

Nothing he had could slow her down since she crushed everything and held him like an insect. While suspended in the air, he understood he had met a dreadful opponent.

“Who are you?!” He bellowed.

Xiaoyue glanced at Li Qiye who still didn’t care for the show.

“Not for you to know.” She said.

“No!” He shouted but it was too late; she added more force and reduced him into a bloody mist.

The lord of Venerable Dragon standing nearby had a hard time standing still upon seeing this.
